formulaCandidate.name: Critical Ising Kramers–Wannier noninvertible defect fusion
formulaCandidate.description: Source's illustrative fusion relation for the Kramers–Wannier duality defect line in the 1+1-dimensional critical Ising conformal field theory.
assumptions: The setting is the 1+1D critical Ising CFT, not an arbitrary (3+1)D gauge theory.
N denotes a topological Kramers–Wannier duality defect line; η_Z2 denotes the invertible Z2 symmetry defect.
Fusion produces a sum of distinct topological defect sectors rather than the identity alone; therefore N has no group inverse within this fusion category.
This is an illustrative special case and is not the complete defining action or fusion rule of all noninvertible generalized symmetries.
variables: ×: topological-defect fusion, not ordinary matrix multiplication
formulaCandidate.units: All symbols are abstract topological fusion-category elements; no physical SI units.
formulaCandidate.regime: Critical 2D Ising CFT; not a universal numerical prediction or a 4D gauge-theory result.
